podcast.body: Released in 2008, this album sold 2.1 million copies and contributed to Coldplay's reputation as potentially the biggest band of that decade. While its record sales were not as high as pre-Napster era albums, the band compensated through massive concert ticket sales. "And when their 2008 album Viva La Vita came out, it all started to come true."

podcast.body: This album features the title track "Viva La Vida," which sparked a "big stink" involving metal guitarist Joe Satriani, who alleged its melody was lifted from his 2004 track "If I Could Fly." "Three years later, Coldplay released the Viva La Vita album and the title track, Well, just have a listen."

podcast.body: This album required the input of four producers to create, and it was mastering engineer Bob Ludwig who provided its final "sparkle." "It took four producers to help Coldplay create the Viva La Vida album."
